edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute between them that is the subject of this settlement (the “Dispute”), on the terms set out below.

2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising from the Dispute based on acts, omissions, or events occurring on or before the date this Agreement is executed by both parties. This release does not extend to claims to enforce this Agreement. Within three business days after receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff shall file a dismissal with prejudice of the claims asserted against Defendant in any pending action concerning the Dispute, with each party bearing its own attorneys’ fees and costs in that action. Defendant shall cooperate in executing any documents reasonably necessary to effect that dismissal.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them as required by applicable law, regulation, or legal process; to its legal, tax, accounting, and other professional advisers who need to know them and are subject to professional or contractual confidentiality duties; or to the extent reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party making a legally compelled disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, give the other party prior notice and disclose only what is required. A party disclosing terms in an enforcement proceeding shall seek confidential treatment to the extent reasonably available.

receiver.message_back: The revised release, confidentiality provisions, and three-business-day dismissal deadline are acceptable in principle, subject to agreement on the complete settlement and execution; please provide your client’s best authorized monetary offer, specifying currency and a firm payment deadline. We also require that late payment leave Plaintiff’s underlying claims intact and permit recovery of reasonable enforcement fees and costs, with no dismissal or release before full cleared payment.
